path_step: Teacher attempts to add a new session with invalid/empty data, triggering an error message.
test_scenario: Verify that the system handles invalid data correctly when a teacher attempts to add a new session.
test_case_title: Attempt to Add Session with Missing Title - Validation Error
pre_condition: A teacher is logged in and has access to a course. The teacher is on the Course Details page, within the 'Sessions' tab, and has opened the 'New Session' modal.
expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the session title cannot be empty, and the teacher remains on the session creation form.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Sessions' tab on the Course Details Page.
Click the 'New Session' button to open the "New Session" modal.
Enter valid data for 'Session Description', 'Date Picker', and 'Time Picker'.
Verify that an error message 'The session title cannot be empty.' is displayed.
Verify that the 'New Session' modal remains open.

uncovered_conditions: AF1: Invalid Data - adding a session (specifically, empty title)
BR-SESSION-01: The session title cannot be empty.
